status: frozen prospective development analysis; no independent test stream
primary_unit: independent development root; paired detector/observable shots within root, regime, and model comparison
primary_metrics: equal-regime paired LER difference versus frozen PyMatching

residual_model.name: residual_position_cnn
residual_model.final_prediction: PyMatching prediction XOR thresholded residual probability

partition_roles.monitor: early stopping and best-checkpoint selection by equal-regime NLL
partition_roles.threshold_selection: one equal-regime LER threshold; ties nearest 0.5 then lower threshold
partition_roles.final_development_evaluation: single post-freeze score; never used for selection

uncertainty.method: two-sided Student-t interval across independent root-level paired outcomes
uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive development uncertainty; not confirmatory inference

decision_rule: No automatic GO claim. A subsequent independent study is considered only if improvement is practically meaningful, reproducible across roots and regimes, and passes a new prospective protocol. A development result cannot establish superiority.
test_access: prohibited; no test seeds allocated, no test arrays generated, no test labels loaded
